description: Lists the VAT return receipts DIY Accounting Submit has stored for the signed-in account, newest first: each row gives the name get_vat_receipt takes, HMRC's form bundle number and the day the return was filed. clientId narrows the list to one of a practice's clients. Use this when the person asks which VAT returns they have filed, for their HMRC receipts, or when a return was last filed. It does not file anything or contact HMRC.

clientId.description: A practice client's id, to list that client's receipts

name: list_vat_receipts
title: List VAT receipts
